description.fun: Wooper lives in cold water, coming ashore on chilly evenings to forage, coated in a slimy, toxic film that keeps its skin from drying out and stings bare hands. Its name comes from 'wooper looper', a name invented in Japan for the axolotl that set off a craze for keeping them as pets. In Paldea, Wooper turned brown and Poison type after being driven onto land.
description.guide: A small, axolotl-like Pokémon of the Water and Ground types that lives in cold water and coats itself in a toxic film on land. Its name comes from 'wooper looper', a Japanese name for the axolotl. It has a Poison and Ground regional form, Paldean Wooper, which evolves into Clodsire.
description.tagline: An axolotl with a toxic coat and a blank stare

description.fun: Driven out of the water long ago, Paldean Wooper adapted to marsh life: its gills hardened into bony shapes, its poison film thickened and it turned Poison and Ground, at the cost of a heavy, slow body. Groups of three or four get Clodsire to ferry them across water.

Quagsire is famously carefree: it bumps its head while swimming and doesn't seem to mind, and it hunts by sitting with its mouth open until food blunders in. Barely moving keeps it from getting hungry, so it can wait as long as it takes, even in its sleep. Its name pairs 'quagmire' with 'sire'.
description.guide: A large amphibian Pokémon of the Water and Ground types and the evolved form of Wooper. It is slow and easygoing, catching food by waiting with its mouth open in the water. It stays submerged to avoid sunlight and is protective of Wooper.
description.tagline: Waits open-mouthed for dinner and never minds the bumps

description.fun: Clodsire is Quagsire's Paldean counterpart: a squat, brown Poison and Ground type that lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps and ferries Paldean Wooper across the water on its back. When attacked it pushes thick spines out of the spots on its back, a risky move that seems borrowed from the Iberian ribbed newt.
description.guide: A Poison and Ground-type Pokémon introduced in Generation 9, the evolved form of Paldean Wooper and the Paldean counterpart of Quagsire. It lives in ponds and swamps and carries Paldean Wooper across water on its back. When attacked, it pushes thick spines out of its back.

note.text: Only Paldean Wooper becomes Clodsire; Wooper from anywhere else becomes Quagsire. Clodsire is the only evolution of a regional form introduced in Generation 9.
